items.title: Warp-Cortex: An Asynchronous, Memory-Efficient Architecture for Million-Agent Cognitive Scaling on Consumer Hardware
items.title_zh: Warp-Cortex：在消费级硬件上实现百万级智能体认知扩展的异步内存高效架构
items.summary: Warp-Cortex decouples agent logic from physical memory through singleton weight sharing and a topological KV-cache sparsification scheme, reducing weight memory to O(1) and context to O(N·k). On a single RTX 4090 it demonstrates 100 concurrent agents in 2.2 GB of VRAM, with a theoretical capacity above 1,000 agents before compute latency becomes the bottleneck.

items.title: Recursive Language Models
items.summary: Recursive Language Models treat long prompts as an external environment that the model can examine, decompose and recursively query, handling inputs up to two orders of magnitude beyond its context window. The authors report outperforming vanilla frontier LLMs and common long-context or coding scaffolds on four long-context tasks at comparable cost, and post-train an initial model at small scale.

items.title: Curator: Efficient Vector Search with Low-Selectivity Filters
items.title_zh: Curator：面向低选择性过滤的高效向量搜索
items.summary: Curator is a partition-based index for filtered approximate nearest-neighbor search, building label-specific indexes inside a shared clustering tree to avoid the connectivity breakdown that graph indexes suffer on low-selectivity filters. Combined with state-of-the-art graph indexes, it cuts low-selectivity query latency by up to 20.9x versus pre-filtering while adding only 5.5% construction time and 4.3% memory.

items.title: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think
items.title_zh: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think：面向韩语语境与智能体能力的开源视觉语言模型
items.summary: HyperCLOVA X 32B Think is a vision-language model pre-trained with an emphasis on reasoning and post-trained for multimodal understanding, agentic behavior and human-preference alignment, with particular attention to Korean language and culture. The team reports strong results against comparably sized models on Korean text and vision benchmarks and on agent-oriented evaluations, and open-sources the model.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Multi-hop Reasoning for Temporal Knowledge Question Answering
items.title_zh: 面向时序知识图谱问答的强化学习增强多跳推理
items.summary: The MRE framework improves temporal knowledge-graph question answering by generating diverse reasoning trajectories, fine-tuning on valid ones as a cold start, and then applying Tree-Group Relative Policy Optimization that explores each hop with feedback from later hops. On two TKGQA benchmarks it consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods and shows better robustness to noisy temporal annotations.

items.title: Bridging the Semantic Gap for Categorical Data Clustering via Large Language Models
items.title_zh: BREVE：借助大模型弥合类别数据聚类的语义鸿沟
items.summary: BREVE enriches each categorical value with a dense embedding drawn from an external knowledge base, appends a lightweight one-hot component to preserve value identity, and uses cluster-compactness-guided weights to control how much enrichment enters the representation. Across eight benchmark datasets it achieves an average ARI rank of 1.3 against seven competitors.

items.title: ScienceDB AI: An LLM-Driven Agentic Recommender System for Large-Scale Scientific Data Sharing Services
items.title_zh: ScienceDB AI：面向大规模科学数据共享服务的 LLM 驱动智能体推荐系统
items.summary: ScienceDB AI is an LLM-driven conversational recommender for a large scientific data-sharing platform, combining a Scientific Intention Perceptor, a Structured Memory Compressor for multi-turn dialogue and a two-stage Trustworthy RAG that returns citable dataset references via CSTR identifiers. It was evaluated on more than 10 million real-world datasets in offline and online experiments.

items.title: Towards Infinite Length Extrapolation: A Unified Approach
items.title_zh: 迈向无限长度外推：一种统一方法
items.summary: The paper recasts positional encoding as a multiplicative transformation plus an additive bias in the attention score, then introduces Adaptive Positional Encoding with adaptive frequency modulation and a combined linear, logarithmic and square-root decay bias. It derives conditions for infinite-context extrapolation and tests the approach on TinyStories and a synthetic dataset with stories up to 32,000 words.

items.title: Snailclimb/interview-guide
items.title_zh: Snailclimb/interview-guide：开源 AI 面试平台
items.summary: interview-guide is an open-source AI interview platform built on Spring Boot 4.1, Java 25, Spring AI 2.0, React, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis and RustFS, supporting resume analysis, mock and voice interviews, and knowledge-base RAG.
